note: Three hand-authored personas for the Ward Round Note documentation-completeness engine. graderHint is set explicitly because bin/test-engines' discovery heuristic picks calculateGrade - the intermediate tally that returns presence/required/recommended objects but no status and no flags - rather than assess, the canonical entry point (spec s6). assess returns status ('complete' at 8/8 required; 'partial' when header AND plan are documented and >= 4 required are; else 'incomplete'), completenessPercent = round(100 x documentedRequired / 8) (62.5 rounds UP to 63 under Math.round), componentStatuses for all ten components, documentedComponents, an audit trail of one fired rule per DOCUMENTED component (required then recommended, in catalogue order) plus a final R-COMPLETENESS-01 row whose description embeds the counts and status, and the safety flags folded in (stable-sorted high > medium > low). Quirks pinned here: an explicit negative ('no changes', 'none outstanding', 'not yet estimable') counts as documented; escalationStatus 'not-recorded' does NOT count as documented; vteStatus 'not-done' DOES count as documented for completeness while simultaneously raising the high-priority F-VTE-NOT-DONE-001 flag; the deteriorating-NEWS2 flag is suppressed whenever a plan or a concrete escalation status exists. The 'timestamp' key is wall-clock and stripped by bin/test-personas. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas ward-round-note --update

personas.name: Complete consultant round - stable pneumonia, EDD set
personas.description: All eight required components and both recommended components documented by the consultant. Medication uses the explicit 'no changes' negative and investigations use free text. NEWS2 2, stable, VTE assessed with prophylaxis, for full escalation, senior present, EDD recorded. Expect status 'complete', 100%, documentedRequired 8, ten component statuses all present, documentedComponents listing all ten in catalogue order, firedRules = eight required + R-OVERNIGHT-DOCUMENTED-01 + R-DISCHARGE-DOCUMENTED-01 + R-COMPLETENESS-01 ('All 8 required components documented - entry complete (100%)'), and no flags.

identification.primaryDiagnosis: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe (CURB-65 2 on admission)

problems.problemList: 1. CAP RLL - day 3 IV co-amoxiclav, improving. 2. T2DM - BMs 6-9. 3. Mild AKI on admission - resolved.

examination.examinationSummary: Alert, comfortable at rest. Chest: reduced air entry R base, crackles resolving. Sats 95% on room air. Apyrexial 24 h.

investigations.investigationsReviewed: CRP 210 -> 68; WCC 14.2 -> 9.8; creatinine back to baseline 82; blood cultures no growth at 48 h.

plan.planAndJobs: Switch to oral co-amoxiclav tomorrow if apyrexial; mobilise with physio; repeat CRP Thursday; discharge planning with family.

summary.clinicalNote: Improving as expected. Aim home in 48 h.

firedRules.description: Header: clinician name, grade, and date/time of review recorded
Problems: the current problem list and progress recorded
Examination: examination summary recorded with a NEWS2 total
Investigations: results reviewed, or "none outstanding" recorded
VTE: assessment status recorded (assessed, not required, or not done)
Medication: changes recorded, or "no changes" recorded
Plan: at least one plan item or job for the day recorded
Escalation: a ceiling-of-care / escalation status recorded
Overnight: events recorded, or "no events overnight" recorded
Discharge: an estimated discharge date, or "not yet estimable" recorded
All 8 required components documented — entry complete (100%)

personas.name: Partial registrar round - three components missing, abnormal potassium not actioned
personas.description: Non-critical edge case for the 'partial' band: header, problems, examination, investigations (via the 'none outstanding' negative) and plan are documented - five of eight required, with header and plan both present - but VTE status is blank, medication has neither changes nor the 'no changes' flag, and escalation is 'not-recorded' (which does not count). Overnight events are documented; estimated discharge is not. Expect status 'partial', completenessPercent 63 (62.5 rounded up), documentedRequired 5, documentedComponents [header, problems, examination, investigations, plan, overnight-events], firedRules = those five required + R-OVERNIGHT-DOCUMENTED-01 + R-COMPLETENESS-01 ('5 of 8 required components documented - entry partial (63%)'), and two flags: F-ABNORMAL-RESULTS-001 (medium; potassium flagged but not actioned) then F-INCOMPLETE-ENTRY-001 (low). NEWS2 3 with a stable trend is below every deterioration trigger.

summary.clinicalNote: Consultant round this afternoon - VTE, medication reconciliation and escalation status to be completed then.

flags.description: An abnormal or critical investigation result is flagged but no corresponding action is recorded
flags.suggestedAction: Record the action taken for the abnormal result, or add it to the plan and jobs.

flags.description: One or more required components are absent — the entry is not fully documented
flags.suggestedAction: Complete the outstanding required components so the ward round note is whole.

personas.name: Incomplete FY1 entry - deteriorating patient, no plan, VTE not done, no senior
personas.description: Critical-highest persona: an FY1 documents a deteriorating post-operative patient (NEWS2 8, a single parameter scoring 3, deteriorating trend) but records no plan or jobs, no escalation status, no medication entry, VTE 'not-done', an abnormal lactate flagged but not actioned, and no senior grade present. Header, problems, examination, investigations and VTE ('not-done' still counts as documented) give 5 of 8 required = 63%, but the missing plan forces status 'incomplete'. Overnight events and 'discharge not yet estimable' are both documented. Expect documentedComponents [header, problems, examination, investigations, vte, overnight-events, estimated-discharge], firedRules = those five required + both recommended + R-COMPLETENESS-01 ('5 of 8 required components documented - entry incomplete (63%)'), and six flags after the stable sort: high F-DETERIORATING-NEWS2-001, F-VTE-NOT-DONE-001, F-NO-PLAN-JOBS-001; medium F-ABNORMAL-RESULTS-001, F-NO-SENIOR-REVIEW-001 (deteriorating-patient wording, since no ceiling-of-care status is recorded); low F-INCOMPLETE-ENTRY-001.
